title: Ashen Realm — detailed materials and dungeon lighting

execution.instruction: Implement this visual-only update on the existing game. Carry forward the earlier CODEX_UPGRADE_INSTRUCTIONS.json. This document specifies the next visual asset pass; it does not waive unfinished premium sculpt, rendered inspection or physical-device gates in the earlier brief.
execution.release: Commit and push the verified source, then save a matching Site version. Do not change site visibility or deploy unless deployment is requested.
execution.completion: Track implemented, structurally tested, visually reviewed, device tested, saved and deployed separately. Never mark unavailable visual evidence as passed. Preserve functional fallbacks for unavailable external assets.

verified: The live guest menu loads. The inspected browser has WebGL disabled; no rendered dungeon frame was obtained.
Ultra already targets a real 3840 by 2160 drawing buffer at 16:9, bounded by hardware limits. Increasing resolution alone does not solve asset quality.

The three characters are articulated authored reconstructions, not completed premium sculpts. They have independent skeleton instances, 13 clips, three LOD meshes and compressed plus PNG fallback GLBs.
The current 4 by 4 material atlas gives each family only 64 to 256 pixels per tile. Its occlusion channel is uniformly white.
Five rooms and four passages use 512 pixel lightmaps with one chart per triangle. Main room charts are approximately 3 to 4 pixels wide.
The current dungeon bake is a diffuse first-bounce patch approximation, not a full global illumination solution.
Existing stone sources include 4K Poly Haven materials. Existing iPhone Auto mode limits resolution, effects and light count.
The baseline passed 65 regression tests, typecheck, syntax check and production build; these do not establish visual quality.
inferences_to_verify: Very small lightmap charts can produce weak gradients and seams.
Repeated tiny character material tiles lose close-up identity and wear detail.
Added geometric detail must be evaluated at real play distance before increasing runtime budgets.

art_direction.thesis: Weathered armor and ancient burial stone lit by restrained amber fire, with cool recesses, physical surface variation and readable silhouettes.

characters.ash-knight: Forged satin steel, shaped plate edges, rivets, chainmail, dark leather, oxblood pleated cloth; preserve weapon and silhouette scale.
characters.crypt-warden: Ash-gray organic skin, subtle veins and healed scars, worn ivory bone plating, readable eye sockets, pointed claws and bone mace.
characters.ember-sovereign: Dark fractured volcanic armor, layered crown and plates, ember fissures occupying a small surface fraction, blackened metal and greatsword.

rooms.entry: Threshold: restrained carved border stones and damp cool entrance masonry.
rooms.cinder: Cinder Crypt: soot-dark burial recesses and iron funerary reliefs.
rooms.dusk: Ossuary: ordered bone and skull reliefs, pale mineral highlights and cold recesses.
rooms.crown: Chapel: carved arches, oxblood hanging cloth and ceremonial wall ornament.
rooms.throne: Hollow Throne: layered broken stone, pointed crown relief and restrained ember accents.

work_packages.name: Character material coverage and surface baking
tasks: Replace the fixed material-slot grid with area-aware unique UV charts using xatlas through watlas, retaining a source material coordinate attribute during baking.
Create true 4096 pixel master atlases from high-detail source fields and generated diffuse material textures; do not merely enlarge the old 1024 pixel atlas.
Bake geometric occlusion from the actual model with deterministic hemisphere rays and use the result in the red ORM channel. Keep color separate from occlusion.
Keep roughness and metalness as independent authored channels and tangent normals derived from explicit surface height fields. Do not claim photographic albedo is a measured PBR scan.
Use MikkTSpace tangents consistently after UV changes and LOD simplification, with finite fallback tangents at degenerate UVs.
Add controlled bevels, cloth folds, rivets and silhouette detail in editable authoring geometry without changing skeleton pivots or weapon reach.
Retain source images, original generation job metadata and honest art-production status. Premium full-anatomy sculpt and deformation approval remain a distinct gate.
acceptance: All three characters have nonconstant geometric AO
Texture manifests list real dimensions and formats
13 clip names and semantic nodes survive
Socket error remains below 0.04 metres
LOD triangles decrease
No source material override silently discards authored normal scale

work_packages.name: Dungeon composition and contact detail
tasks: Add shallow modular wall reliefs, carved stone borders, burial skull details, banner folds and crown ornament that distinguish the existing five rooms.
Keep all additions on existing wall, ceiling and throne surfaces; do not add invisible obstacles to open combat lanes.
Preserve shared material batches and independent room streaming; use vertex tint where sufficient to vary age, soot and dampness.
Preserve Poly Haven texture scale and color/data conventions.
acceptance: Nine chunks remain independently streamable
At most ten material batches per room
Protected dungeon and model files are byte-identical
New geometry has finite bounds

work_packages.name: Continuous lightmaps and directional ambient assets
tasks: Replace per-triangle UV1 grids with contiguous area-weighted charts, adequate padding and explicit edge dilation.
Bake at 1024 pixels for rooms with smaller passage maps; record chart count, utilization, map dimensions and hashes.
Sample static architecture visibility for indirect light and contact occlusion; exclude actors, moving gates and shrine activation states.
Keep a clear declaration of the actual offline approximation used. Do not label it path-traced GI or Cycles unless that renderer actually produced the asset.
Add directional low-order diffuse probe coefficients matched to room palette, with smooth room blending and conservative intensity.
Preserve the bounded torch pool, motivated shadow source, exposure, renderer and graphics defaults.
acceptance: UV1 charts are non-overlapping within raster tolerance
Padding is valid at shipped map resolution
Irradiance is linear and does not include albedo
No permanent active-shrine light is baked
Lightmap ownership and disposal tests pass

work_packages.name: Restrained fire and impact presentation
tasks: Remove frame-border leakage with explicit atlas UV bounds, mip-safe insets and a short crossfade between adjacent flame frames where affordable.
Use a rounded, soft-edged contact particle presentation with size and opacity following lifetime, rather than square points.
Retain fixed particle capacity, current impact timing, reduced-motion behavior and one pooled particle draw.
Do not add fullscreen haze, heavy motion blur, depth of field or camera shake.
acceptance: No new gameplay clock
Repeated impacts expire and reuse existing buffers
Reduced motion remains honored
Shader compilation is separately identified as requiring a GPU

work_packages.name: Mobile-safe quality variants
tasks: Ship low 512 pixel and mobile 1024 pixel character atlases with a desktop HD 2048 pixel tier and Ultra 4096 pixel hero/boss color where useful; use smaller data maps and enemy variants as appropriate.
Encode color/emission as ETC1S and normal/ORM as UASTC with mipmaps. Keep PNG fallback GLBs capped at mobile-safe map sizes for decoder failures.
Keep one material draw per LOD unless a measured visual benefit warrants another, and share templates across monsters.
Keep replacements serialized and release superseded images, textures, geometry and skeletons.
Report compressed download bytes and worst-case RGBA8 mip allocation separately. Never treat transfer size as GPU memory.
Keep true 4K output available as explicit Ultra; preserve adaptive iPhone Auto and Performance controls.
acceptance: No automatic Ultra on iPhone
Fallback memory remains bounded
All runtime map headers identify actual universal compression
Quality changes coalesce
No increase in simultaneous shader light count

Inspect exported texture masters. Compare neutral and dungeon character views plus entrance, Warden and boss scenes at identical camera, exposure and resolution when a supported WebGL environment is available.

Provide an implementation report mapping every package to evidence and remaining art or device gates.
Commit and push matching source, package a verified archive and save the next Site version.

All structural checks pass
No missing runtime asset

quality_targets.status: Proposed asset budgets; actual device performance must be measured.
quality_targets.memory_policy: Account for one old/new character overlap during replacement. Lower fallback texture dimensions before increasing device defaults. 4096 square RGBA8 with full mipmaps alone is about 85.33 MiB.
